How scheduling works

New cards enter learning. Again schedules one minute, Hard six minutes, Good ten minutes, and Easy four days. A second Good graduates a learning card to a daily review. Later reviews use an SM-2-style ease and interval calculation. A lapse returns the card to learning. Bury hides a card until tomorrow; Suspend hides it until you restore it. Preview sessions never alter review dates.

This is a browser-based scheduler. Export a JSON backup to move your progress between browsers, or CSV to import the cards into Anki.
